newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Whimsy places 47.6 million warrants.
newsitem.headline: Whimsy places 47.6 million warrants.

text.p: Public amusement centre operator Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to privately place 47.6 million warrants through placing agents to third party investors at HK$0.55 each.
Each warrant will entitle holders to the right to subscribe for one new company share at HK$1.30 each at any time from June 11, 1997, to December 10, 1998, Whimsy said in a statement.
A total 47.6 million new shares, or 16.67 percent of the enlarged share capital, will be issued upon exercise of the warrants, it said.
Proceeds of the warrants issue of HK$24.6 million will be used for additional working capital, it added.
Whimsy shares rose HK$0.09 to HK$1.70 in early trade.
